args.title: Re-enable ExportButton after failed export by resetting busy state
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `busy` state is only reset in the success path of `exportReport` (inside `.then()`), but not in the failure path. If the export fails (e.g., due to a server error), the `busy` state remains `true`, disabling the button permanently until a page reload. The fix is to reset `setBusy(false)` in the `.catch()` block of the `exportReport` call, ensuring the button is re-enabled after any export attempt, successful or not.
